notes:
Composed of ⟦{後援|こうえん}→後援：12616_kouen⟧ (support, backing) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Used in political, cultural, and business contexts for someone who provides backing, whether financial, organizational, or moral.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後援者|こうえんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to gather supporters
- ⟦{有力|ゆうりょく}→有力：13007_yuuryoku⟧な{後援者|こうえんしゃ}: influential backer
- {後援者|こうえんしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧: donation from a patron
- {後援者|こうえんしゃ}⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧: list of supporters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支援者|しえんしゃ}→支援者：24919_shiensha⟧: supporter — more general, includes any type of support
- ⟦{応援者|おうえんしゃ}→応援者：24483_ouensha⟧: cheerleader, supporter — more informal, emphasizes encouragement
- ⟦スポンサー→スポンサー：11584_suponsaa⟧: sponsor — loanword, typically implies financial support

definitions.explanation: a person who provides support, backing, or sponsorship for someone or something, especially financially or politically

examples.japanese: {後援者|こうえんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後援者|こうえんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支|ささ}えられている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: He is supported by many backers.
